sources.entry: AirTrail - Personal flight tracking system. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: AirTrail is a self-hostable web application for logging your flights, viewing them on a world map, and reviewing your flight history and statistics.
summary.what_it_does: AirTrail is a web app for tracking personal flights and browsing flight history. It shows all of a user's flights on an interactive world map and keeps a flight history list in one place. It provides statistics summarizing that history. It supports multiple users, with flight sharing between them, user authentication, and integration with an OAuth provider. The interface is responsive and offers light and dark modes. Flights can be imported from MyFlightRadar24, App in the Air, JetLog, TripIt, Flighty, byAir, JetLovers and OpenFlights.
use_cases: view flights on a world map
import flights from TripIt or Flighty
notable: Imports flight data from many services including MyFlightRadar24, App in the Air, TripIt, Flighty and OpenFlights
Multi-user support with flight sharing and OAuth provider integration
Interactive world map of all logged flights
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under Maps and GPS
